up: Retrieve exact IC50 values (in nM) for compounds tested against the target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3397. Return the compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, target name, and target organism. Filter for exact IC50 activity values (standard_relation = '=') with standard_units = 'nM'. Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, compound_records, and docs. Order by compound ChEMBL ID.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key, d.pubmed_id, d.doi, ass.description AS assay_description, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, a.standard_value AS ic50_nM FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3397' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' ORDER BY md.chembl_id
